query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T20:07:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T20:08:00Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.21" AND destination.ip == "172.18.0.12" AND destination.port == 5432
| STATS count = COUNT(*), total_dest_bytes = SUM(destination.bytes), total_src_bytes = SUM(source.bytes), max_dest_bytes = MAX(destination.bytes), max_src_bytes = MAX(source.bytes), avg_dest_bytes = AVG(destination.bytes), avg_src_bytes = AVG(source.bytes), min_ts = MIN(@timestamp), max_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
| SORT count DESC
